name: @medienreaktor/neos-studio
description: Public plugin API type declarations for Neos Studio. Consumed by plugin packages; the shell provides the implementation at runtime on window.NeosStudio.
comment: index.d.ts is GENERATED from ../Studio/src/plugin-api/index.ts (the single source of truth) and committed so plugins can typecheck without a build step. Regenerate with `npm install && npm run build` here whenever the plugin API changes. The isolated toolchain pins classic TypeScript 5 because the shell builds with the TypeScript 7 native compiler, which the declaration bundler does not support.
